ExampleDefinition.Description:
Demonstrates how to use the DataLabelProvider API to display text labels at data points. This example shows:
- Column series with color-coded labels (green for positive, orange for negative values) - Line series with labels sourced from point metadata - Bubble series with standard numeric labels - Spline series with labels shown only at peaks and troughs
Click on a series to select it, then use the toolbar to adjust DataLabelProvider settings for the selected series.
The DataLabelProvider supports customizable label text formatting, horizontal and vertical anchor points, skip modes for overlapping labels, and point count thresholds.
